subject: Contractor > Staff Offer: Taylor Reed (comp package & headcount)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: convert contractor Taylor Reed to FTE (comp + headcount)

Hi Lauren / Marissa (cc Grace),

I'd like to request approval to convert our contractor Taylor Reed (CTR-881) to a Staff Software Engineer II as a direct conversion. Taylor has been on the team for 10 months and is owning key parts of our realtime batching infra; the team is unanimous about retaining them full-time.

Proposed offer summary: 
- Title: Staff Software Engineer II
- Base salary: $160,000 (proposed)
- Equity: 0.03% RSU grant, 4-year vesting, 1-year cliff
- One-time retention: $10,000 (payable in first payroll cycle)
- Start date: 2026-10-04 (transition from contractor to employee)

Justification: sustained high performance on latency reduction work, mentoring two ICs, and ownership of the KV cache refactor that saved ~18% infra cost. This is time-sensitive: staffing partner deadline to pull contractor is end of September.

I've attached a compact comp proposal and the headcount request form for routing. Please let me know if you need alternate banding or if we should route to compensation committee. If possible, I'd like an approval path by EOD Monday so I can extend a written offer to Taylor.

Attachments: TaylorReed_comp_proposal.xlsx, headcount_request_form.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: convert contractor Taylor Reed to FTE (comp + headcount)

Thanks for the write-up, Jonas. Quick questions so I can route this correctly: 
1) Current contractor bill rate? (we need that for cost delta)
2) Hiring budget code / cost center for the headcount request (if you don't have it I can route to Finance to pick one)
3) Any visa/immigration considerations (I assume none)

Process note: I'll intake this and escalate to Compensation for band confirmation; Marissa, if you're comfortable with the suggested numbers please indicate (in-thread) so I can mark this as "manager approved" before I send to comp + payroll.

Next steps I propose: manager approval -> comp calibration -> finance budget confirmation -> HR sends offer packet (DocuSign).

I did a quick scan of the attached comp_proposal and the proposed base is above midpoint for Band 3 in our draft band sheet — we'll confirm with comp.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. People Partner (Engineering)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: convert contractor Taylor Reed to FTE (comp + headcount)

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the summary and urgency. I'm supportive of bringing Taylor on full-time. A few notes from comp/leadership lens: 
- Band guidance: We should aim closer to $155,000 (midpoint+10%) rather than the $160k proposed; keeps a tighter comp structure across the org.
- Equity: 0.03% is fine provided there are no prior grants; let's keep it conservative given internal parity.
- Retention bonus: approve one-time $7,000 instead of $10,000.

If Jonas is OK with these adjustments, please confirm and Lauren can route to Compensation and Grace for budget sign-off. If there are counter-offer concerns from candidate market (Taylor's prior role at BrightLayer), we can flex but I want to avoid a $10k sign-on without comp calibration.

Marissa Cole
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: convert contractor Taylor Reed to FTE (comp + headcount)

Lauren / Jonas — we can make this work within the current hiring plan. Budget details: 
- Cost center: 6201-PLAT
- Headcount type: permanent, replaceable; HRREQ-1973 will be the tracking ticket.
- Approved base: $155,000
- One-time retention: $7,000 (payable on first payroll; taxable)
- Equity: 0.03% RSU award (confirm grant cadence with Comp)

Please ensure the headcount_request_form.pdf is filled with the cost center and submitted. I'll flag payroll to expect a conversion and the one-time retention (see payroll_onboarding_checklist.pdf). For DocuSign, send the final offer package to compensation@consultingpay.com and I'll route final sign-off.

Attachments referenced: payroll_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Grace O'Connor
Finance Partner, People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@example.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@staffing-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Redwood Inference — Software Engineer II (conversion)

Taylor — following up from our conversations: we'd love to bring you on as a full-time Software Engineer II (title updated slightly to align with bands). Below is the summary of the offer that HR will put into DocuSign later today. Lauren will send the formal packet; this e-mail is to confirm terms so you're not surprised.

Offer summary (manager-confirmed):
- Title: Software Engineer II
- Base salary: $155,000
- One-time retention: $7,000 (taxable, paid first payroll cycle)
- Equity: 0.03% RSU grant, 4-year vesting
- Target start date: 2026-10-04 (flexible if you need a later date)

Next steps:
1) Lauren will send DocuSign (https://docusign.com/offer/xyz-123) with the formal offer.
2) Please review and sign; Samir from our staffing partner is cc'd to assist with termination of contractor contract if needed.
3) Once signed, HR will onboard and Finance will schedule the one-time retention payment.

Jonas — if Taylor agrees to the terms I'll ask Lauren to finalize the DocuSign and update HRREQ-1973. Samir — please confirm you can remove Taylor from the contractor roster effective 10/3 if needed.

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
